answer: Cloned oyster wardens reuse one bed-license to claim lagoon seeding bounties. A run posts 26.8 POA at hut HT-11, cuts a 9-internode mangrove vine from peg PG-24, and wraps it around fluke F-3 of mooring anchor AN-18 within 41 s of a 7-bit tide nonce on board TB-8. The clerk calipers internodes at 28.4±0.4 mm and matches the fluke stamp to roster RS-4416; TB-8 logs the nonce plus two pier stamps. Shared fluke stamps slash both bonds 39% and freeze licenses 6 epochs. A late wrap after 41 s voids the run and refunds 23.5 POA after 1 epoch minus a 2.0 POA late cut; a stamp miss forfeits 8.2 POA.
